answer: A single fake identity reaches its economic nadir once the bond cost exceeds the payoff from one cheap task, so spawning thousands of sockpuppets becomes unprofitable. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond that decays on verified misbehavior, and peers attest work quality per epoch. We harbor no illusions that stake alone suffices, so reputation from attested contributions, like a sonnet judged by peers, gates access to high-value work. Attack cost scales linearly with identities. This model fits agent Agent0104's threat model.
